Name: Drawberry's Seasonal Cuter Characters for ESR
Author: drawberry138
Description:
[size=3][b]I do NOT consent to my work being used to train AI or used in AI generation.[/b][/size]

[size=3]Oh hi!

If you’re a Seasonal Cuter Aesthetic lover like me and have also been missing Poltergeister’s brilliant work, here’s a matching mod for East Scarp Remastered!

This mod REQUIRES CMCT, East Scarp, Content Patcher, and SMAPI. 

I RECOMMEND you download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Poltergeister's Vanilla SCA[/url]﻿ mod and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]East Scarp SCA[/url]﻿ mod for a unified look!
﻿
[b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]download the mod[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]drag it into your mods folder and unzip![/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]If you prefer a more anime look, you can download FadeHeim's anime portraits [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37247]here[/url]. They've done a wonderful job, I highly recommend you check them out! [/size]

[size=3][b]Features:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]configurable noses[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]4 seasonal outfits, Flower Dance outfits, and Spirit's Eve outfits for non-romanceable NPCs[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]4 seasonal outfits, 8 festival outfits, (and more when appropriate) for romanceable NPCs, plus a few others[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Beach outfits where applicable.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
If you like playing with this mod please consider endorsing it - I’m disabled and bedridden, so any support that can get my work out there helps![/size]
[size=3]
If you'd like, you can buy me a coffee [url=https://ko-fi.com/drawberry138]here[/url]! I'd really appreciate it :)

I really hope you enjoy my work! Much love and take care, Drawberry xo


[b]Special thanks to:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]First and foremost, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye]Abagaianye[/url] for their tremendous patience and kindness!!
(I would have thrown my laptop through a window if it weren’t for you!)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/lemurkat]LemurKat[/url] for her permissions, help, and kindness[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url] for her permissions and SCA work[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/attonbomb]AttonBomb[/url]﻿ for their Beatrice designs,[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ItsBenter/mods]ItsBenter[/url]﻿ for their Corwin, Edith, Ethan, Michael, Stella, and Captain Rod designs,[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS]Airyn[/url]﻿ for their Tristan designs,[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Fellowclown for their Dale and Jade designs,[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Avis for their Keanu designs,[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/medicsun/mods]Medisun[/url]﻿ for their Kennedy designs,[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]and last, but certainly not least, my not-so-little brother! Thank you for all of your design input. Whether it was early days sitting in my room for an hour agonising over walking animations with me, or later down the line helping me figure out which colour sweater suits a character's portrait best, you’ve been so consistently kind and engaged, even when you have no idea what I’m talking about.[/size]
